title: Generic UE configuration update accepted by the UE

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE processes CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message to update stored configuration information and may send CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to update UE configuration parameters.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE when acknowledgement is requested in CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND.

entities.name: Configuration update indication IE
entities.description: Information element containing Acknowledgement bit and Registration requested bit.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier used for UE identification.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list defining UE's registration area.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information allowed for UE.

entities.name: CAG information list IE
entities.description: Closed Access Group information list defining CAG access permissions.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer stopped when UE receives CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.

entities.name: T3519
entities.description: Timer stopped when UE receives new 5G-GUTI in CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: State entered when UE cannot access normal services due to CAG restrictions.

entities.name: Acknowledgement requested
entities.description: Condition when Acknowledgement bit is set in Configuration update indication IE.

entities.name: Update stored UE information
entities.description: UE updates appropriate stored information based on CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND contents.

relations.description: Procedure starts with receiving CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND contains Configuration update indication IE.
When acknowledgement is requested, UE sends CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message.
UE stops timer T3346 upon receiving CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND.
UE updates stored information based on CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND contents.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND may contain 5G-GUTI IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND may contain TAI list IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND may contain Allowed NSSAI IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND may contain CAG information list IE.
Based on CAG information list content, UE may enter LIMITED-SERVICE state.
